sumTheDigits.name: Sum the digits
sumTheDigits.description: Write a function called digitalRoot that takes a number and adds its digits together. For numbers that are already a single digit, and for numbers whose digits sum to a single digit, this first pass is enough.

collapseToSingleDigit.name: Keep collapsing until one digit is left
collapseToSingleDigit.description: Sometimes summing the digits once still leaves more than one digit (for example 942 sums to 15). Keep summing the digits of the result until a single digit remains.

drSingleDigit.name: Already a single digit
drSingleDigit.description: A number that is already a single digit is its own digital root.

drTwoDigits.name: Two digits
drTwoDigits.description: 16 collapses to 7 in a single pass (1 + 6).

drThreeDigits.name: Three digits, one pass
drThreeDigits.description: 132 collapses to 6 in a single pass (1 + 3 + 2).

drThirtyNine.name: Two passes needed
drThirtyNine.description: 39 sums to 12, which then sums to 3.

drTwoPasses.name: A number that needs a second pass
drTwoPasses.description: 942 sums to 15, which then sums to 6.

drLarge.name: A larger number
drLarge.description: 493193 collapses all the way down to 2.

drNines.name: All nines
drNines.description: 99999 sums to 45, which then sums to 9.

whatIsIt.question: What exactly is a digital root?
whatIsIt.answer: Add up all the digits of the number. If that gives you a single digit, that's the answer. If it gives you more than one digit, add up the digits of that result too, and keep going until only one digit is left.

sumDigits.question: How do I add up the digits of a number?
sumDigits.answer: Turn the number into a string so you can walk through it character by character with a `for...of` loop. Keep a running total, adding each digit as you go.

digitsToNumbers.question: Each digit is a character though, not a number.
digitsToNumbers.answer: When you loop over the string, each character (like `"4"`) is text. Use `Number(char)` to turn it into the number `4` before adding it to your total.

whichLoop.question: How do I keep going without knowing how many passes I need?
whichLoop.answer: You don't know in advance how many times you'll need to sum the digits, so a `while` loop is a great fit. Keep looping while the number is still 10 or more (i.e. has more than one digit).

keepGoing.question: When do I stop?
keepGoing.answer: Stop as soon as the number is a single digit, which means it's less than 10. At that point, return it.

checks.mustUseWhile: Almost! For this exercise we want you to use a `while` loop to keep collapsing until a single digit remains.
